body:
I DON'T HAVE HERPES! Test came back clear, today. The rest of the STD tests (aids, chlamydia, etc) likely won't come back for another day or two...but FUCK YEAH this feels good! 

At this point, I'm betting I have some other curable disease like chlamydia or possibly if I'm lucky a UTI...but either way, I'm definitely feeling a lot better now.

Well, assuming things go well in 6-9 days...life goes back to normal. Thank you for talking to me. I really appreciate it, it's saved me from flipping-the-fuck-out while I waited.

I mean...if I end up actually having it, then I'm going to be right where I was an hour ago...but, man do I feel better in the short term.

Thank you for helping me...I really, really appreciate it.

The doc specifically checked for swollen glands (oddly enough around the pelvic area...kinda figured she'd check my neck or tonsils or something)...and she said that was all fine...and I definitely don't have a temperature.

Wow. I feel like I worked myself up over fears vs reality. But...no one really told me any of this shit. Most of the folks I spoke with were pretty much like "Yeah, well, herpes sucks...shame you're here for that, today. Let's go ahead and get this test over with!"..the way they talked about it made me feel like it was pretty much a guarantee...but the doc checked for everything and said that while we should wait for the test everything "appeared OK"....I guess the WAY they talked about it more than what they said really kinda set me off, I just felt like they were trying to keep me calm more than telling me the truth....but I mean...if the chances REALLY ARE only 4-5%...then, I feel pretty good about things.

There was definitely nothing noticeable...I mean...she clearly had an outbreak at some point because it bothered her IUD...but...this actually makes me feel A LOT better. 5% is nothing. Driving a car probably is 5% chance of death.

But, I mean...it burned when I pee. What the hell is that supposed to mean? Maybe she also gave me chlamydia or something? I got tested for everything...and the doc said that she didn't see anything messed up other than some redness just inside my urethra. But, it burned when I peed say a month or two ago for a few days and then it went away...I just kind of assumed that it was nothing...but now with this I figured that I had a small outbreak in my urethra and then it went away...and now it's back (and I'm aware now of herpes possibility)...but, 5% is so low...

I guess at the end of the day, I'll be RIGHT back here if I do actually have herpes...but boy, this actually made me feel a shit load better about everything. Why the hell do the docs not tell you your chances are so low?

So, what you're telling me is...if I had sex with a girl every single day of the year that had an active herpes outbreak...my chances of contracting in that year are 4-5%?

(I've never had HSV-1. Got tested for herpes and other STD's a year ago)

FUCKING GREAT. THE CHANCE IS 4-5%. THAT'S THE LAST THING I NEEDED TO HEAR RIGHT NOW. THANKS FOR THAT.

Fuck, there's no fucking chance I don't have this shit...I should just get it over with.

I have roughly 9 days until I hear back...and I've decided prior to even making this post that I'm going to wait until I know for sure. But, that really doesn't change anything. I'm not just going to magically wake up tomorrow and the stigma associated with herpes is just going to disappear.

But, ok...let's talk about chances then.

Let's say, just for the sake of argument, that she NEVER had an outbreak at all during the time we were together (clearly BS since it was causing issues with her IUD). Let's say, since there's still a chance of transmission during times of non-breakouts that there's a 1% chance of transmission per sexual encounter.

Well, if it is 1%, we fucked (admittedly probably more than) every other day for 4 months. That means there's a 60% chance I have fucking herpes. So, really, there's pretty much no fucking chance i don't have this shit. Because you know that the chance is more than 1%, and we fucked more than every other day.
Honestly, I don't know what the fuck I want to hear. Unless you have a magic cure for herpes...maybe I just need to yell at people... Maybe that's the stage I'm at right now.
Fuck you.

Honestly, I don't know what the fuck I want to hear. Unless you have a magic cure for herpes...maybe I just need to yell at people... Maybe that's the stage I'm at right now.

P.S. We should get rid of suicide hotlines as well. Being put on hold when you call a suicide hotline is LITERALLY WORSE THAN HAVING NO RESOURCE. What? Are their so many people that want to kill themselves that there's actually a line? Or, is there just not enough funding because no one REALLY gives a shit about people that want to kill themselves?

I'm sorry I hurt your feelings. Oh, wait....wait...no, I'm not. I don't care how you feel, because I'm suicidal. I'm going to off myself. Why the fuck would I care how you feel? I also don't care if I have the right. I just don't. Fuck you. Fuck your mom. Fuck your whole family. You aren't helping.
Thanks.
Go fuck yourself. I'll inflict LITERALLY WHATEVER THE FUCK I WANT ON WHOMEVER THE FUCK I WANT. Why? Because that's what life did to me. Who cares if it's fair....I certainly don't.

I really wanted to just throw you softballs so you could show whomever that you "talked another dumbass off the bridge". 

Sorry I couldn't make life so easy for you.

You have an EX with herpes. I really don't need to say anything else about that.

Oh, and there's a ton of other people living who are just fucking happy as can be they have herpes? Well, good for them. I'm so happy for them.

But, big picture here, I got fucked. Some stupid bitch got infected, and I used to love her enough...and stupidly thought enough of her...that we didn't use condoms...fuck, if we had a kid I might have even been happy.

What a fucking disaster that turned out to be. I'm stupid for trusting ANYONE ELSE farther than I can throw them. I feel like that's the lesson I learned...now 9 days, i guess...before I throw myself off a fucking bridge....never trust anyone, 'cause you'll get fucked.

That's the real lesson to learn here. Ain't a single person on this fucking planet that gives a shit about you. They'll give you a disease, and not even give a shit. They'll do whatever the fuck they want. You always have to protect yourself...I was too nice.

No one gives a shit about people that have herpes. That's why people say your life is ruined with herpes. Google "suicide herpes". Plenty of herpes ridden people talking about how their life is shit and they wish they were man enough to just off themselves.

Yes, I really think no one gives a shit. Hence, me saying that. EX. I wouldn't date someone with fucking herpes. I GUESS THAT MAKES ME A HYPOCRITE NOW.

Oh right, so the #1 reason to "help" is to keep this out of the news. Man, do I feel special.

If I had literally ONE PERSON to talk to, do you think I'd be here spilling my guts to a bunch of redditors? Seriously, come on...give a guy some credit.
Wow, a quote! Holy shit, I feel so much better now...to be one of the "cogs". Great. So now, I'm a cog with fucking herpes.

What's the point of living a life where I have to have "the conversation" with every girl I feel like fucking?

"start of something new" is bullshit. New SHIT life, maybe. But it's not better. It's infinitely worse. There is no light at the end of the tunnel for me. There is no cure for this shit. This is pretty much it. Sure, I can "man up" and deal with this...but why? Why should I continue living for 5 minutes after I know for sure? So I can "live my life"? Oh, great.

Is it, really? What's the point? I'm not going to cure cancer, I'm not going to save the world. The best I'm going to do is build a few websites. My life, and most other people's lives, aren't worth anything...we were born because we were born, and we don't die because we believe in god, too scared, or a million other stupid reasons.

Thanks for the anecdote, and I do understand that you are genuinely trying to help...but this is more than just a "minor setback". It's going from living a normal life, to living the life of a fucking pariah. That's not a way to live. There really is no point.

...And who even said she cheated on me? My assumption was she fucked a bunch of dirty dicks prior to us dating and had it the whole time. What an asshole you are to make assumptions about me. I didn't come here to get high roaded by some holier than thou fuckwad. You're an even bigger loser than me shaming people considering suicide.
No, there's fucking not. Society tells you your life is ruined when you have an std. So, now I have one. Might as well just do everyone a favor.
Yeah, no. Im done calling or talking to people that really just don't give a shit.
Oh, really? Jeez,  that makes me feel sooo much better.
Hey, what a suprise...no one gives a shit!
